content.title: IndyCar Series leaderboard, results at Long Beach: Alex Palou wins for third time this season
content.text: Updated April 19, 2026, 8:53 p.m. ETAlex Palou runs away for his third IndyCar Series win of the season at the Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach.Pole-sitter Felix Rosenqvist finishes second and Scott Dixon completes the podium.Alex Palou takes advantage of the day's only caution to slip by pole-sitter Felix Rosenqvist during a late pit stop and earn his third IndyCar Series win of the season. Palou reaches the Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach finish line 4+ seconds sooner than Rosenqvist, taking the points lead from Kyle Kirkwood, who finishes 4th. Scott Dixon finishes 3rd in the 90-lap race on the 11-turn, 1.97-mile street course for his first podium of the season.The race was clean until a piece of carbon from a car fell into the driving line on the track, bringing out the Lap 58 caution.Nolan Siegel, who started last, finishes 12th, up 13 spots. Marcus Armstrong finishes 24th, down 11 from the start. Who won the IndyCar race today in Long Beach? "I’ll take Alex Palou to win at Long Beach for the first time. Rosenqvist has finished in the top 10 at Long Beach three years in a row." Who won the IndyCar race at Long Beach in 2025?
